mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subscriptions (id, tenant_key, external_subscription_id, external_customer_id, status, plan_id, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at, subject_type, subject_key, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (COALESCE(#{id}::uuid, gen_random_uuid()), #{tenantKey}, #{externalSubscriptionId}, #{externalCustomerId}, #{status}, #{planId}, #{currentPeriodStart}, #{currentPeriodEnd}, #{cancelAtPeriodEnd}, #{canceledAt}, COALESCE(#{subjectType}, 'TENANT'), COALESCE(#{subjectKey}, #{tenantKey}), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, now()), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, now())) ON CONFLICT (external_subscription_id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, current_period_start = EXCLUDED.current_period_start, current_period_end = EXCLUDED.current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end = EXCLUDED.cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at = EXCLUDED.canceled_at, subject_type = EXCLUDED.subject_type, subject_key = EXCLUDED.subject_key, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_key, external_subscription_id, external_customer_id, status, plan_id, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at, subject_type, subject_key, created_at, updated_at FROM subscriptions WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey} AND status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unpaid') ORDER BY current_period_end DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_key, external_subscription_id, external_customer_id, status, plan_id, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at, subject_type, subject_key, created_at, updated_at FROM subscriptions WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, tenant_key, external_subscription_id, external_customer_id, status, plan_id, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at, subject_type, subject_key, created_at, updated_at FROM subscriptions WHERE subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_key = #{subjectKey} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, tenant_key, external_subscription_id, external_customer_id, status, plan_id, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at, subject_type, subject_key, created_at, updated_at FROM subscriptions WHERE subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_key = #{subjectKey} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_key, external_subscription_id, external_customer_id, status, plan_id, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at, subject_type, subject_key, created_at, updated_at FROM subscriptions WHERE external_subscription_id = #{externalSubscriptionId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_key, external_subscription_id, external_customer_id, status, plan_id, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at, subject_type, subject_key, created_at, updated_at FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'trialing' AND current_period_end BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY current_period_end ASC

SELECT id, tenant_key, external_subscription_id, external_customer_id, status, plan_id, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at, subject_type, subject_key, created_at, updated_at FROM subscriptions WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, tenant_key, external_subscription_id, external_customer_id, status, plan_id, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at, subject_type, subject_key, created_at, updated_at FROM subscriptions WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE subscriptions SET status = #{status}, current_period_end = #{currentPeriodEnd}, cancel_at_period_end = #{cancelAtPeriodEnd}, canceled_at = #{canceledAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
